helm_history_entries.name: helm_history_entries
helm_history_entries.sql: CREATE TABLE `helm_history_entries` (`created_at` INTEGER, `updated_at` INTEGER, `id` INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL, `source` TEXT, `status` TEXT, `duration_ms` INTEGER, `executed_at` INTEGER, `target` TEXT, `target_context` TEXT, `pinned` TEXT, `user` INTEGER, `team` INTEGER, `project` INTEGER, `environment` INTEGER, `app` INTEGER, `mode` TEXT)

indexes.name: helm_history_retention
indexes.sql:
CREATE INDEX helm_history_retention
      ON helm_history_entries (pinned, executed_at, id)

indexes.name: helm_history_scope
indexes.sql:
CREATE INDEX helm_history_scope
      ON helm_history_entries (
        user,
        project,
        environment,
        pinned,
        executed_at DESC
      )
